job.title: Consultant / Senior Architect / Senior Business Consultant (m/w/d) - PIM / MDM
job.email_subject: Application: Consultant / Business Consultant PIM / MDM – Kranti Chavan
job.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Your PIM / MDM clients need consultants who connect business goals with real data flows – I designed and optimized Profisee MDM, SAP ERP and commerce integrations at Rockwell Automation.

– PIM-to-Hybris pipelines with Profisee, Hotfolders and DataHub; SAP ERP / MDM integration
– Requirements analysis, user stories, functional specifications and UAT with business teams
– Product catalog, data modeling and data consistency across global channels

I bring both the business-consulting and the architecture perspective, and Heidelberg is close to my home in Karlsruhe. My CV and cover letter are attached. I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16 December 2026 after my notice period. Could we arrange a short call this week or next?

Kind regards
Kranti Chavan

tailoring.headline: Consultant / Business Consultant PIM / MDM | Profisee, SAP ERP & Commerce Integration
tailoring.summary: Techno-functional consultant with 5+ years designing and optimizing PIM / MDM data integrations for enterprise commerce platforms (SAP Commerce Cloud / Hybris) at Rockwell Automation and Shell. Built PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines with Profisee, Hotfolders and DataHub and resolved integration bottlenecks between SAP ERP, MDM and Profisee with international teams. Strong in requirements engineering, data modeling, process mapping, functional specifications, solution design and UAT, backed by Java, SQL and REST APIs. Uses generative AI tools for analysis and documentation.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

tailoring.why_company: Hiveway is specialised in PIM and MDM, the topic where I have created the most value: synchronised product data across global channels at Rockwell Automation. I want to bring that hands-on MDM, ERP and commerce integration experience to your consulting projects and grow with a focused, specialised team in Heidelberg.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello, I am applying for Consultant / Business Consultant PIM / MDM at Hiveway: Profisee MDM, SAP ERP and SAP Commerce integration at Rockwell Automation, 5+ years techno-functional, Karlsruhe-based. Happy to talk!

en.subject: Application: Consultant / Senior Business Consultant – PIM / MDM
en.hook: PIM / MDM projects need consultants who can design the target data flows with the business and know how they behave in real systems. That is my background: at Rockwell Automation I designed, built and optimized PIM-to-commerce pipelines with Profisee, Hotfolders and DataHub and resolved integration bottlenecks between SAP ERP, MDM and Profisee.

bullets.label: PIM / MDM architecture in practice
bullets.text: Designed, built and optimized PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines with Profisee, Hotfolders and DataHub; investigated and resolved integration bottlenecks between SAP ERP, MDM and Profisee with international technical teams.

bullets.label: Business consulting
bullets.text: Analysed requirements with business stakeholders and product owners, wrote user stories and functional specifications, mapped processes and supported user acceptance testing (UAT) – then translated them into working SAP Commerce solutions.

bullets.label: Commerce channel know-how
bullets.text: Designed and implemented backend and frontend functionality for product, catalog, pricing and customer data on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211); developed and maintained the Promotions Engine, Order Management (OMS), Cronjobs, Impex and FlexibleSearch.

bullets.label: Data consistency & migration
bullets.text: Engineered API migrations for customer account structures, improving system stability and data consistency, and resolved integration bottlenecks between SAP ERP, MDM and Profisee.

I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16 December 2026 after my notice period. I would be glad to show you in a conversation how I can contribute from day one.
